issues.detail: The instructions lack coverage of error handling and edge cases such as connection failures or storage eviction.

scenarios.name: persistent-browser-notes
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully implements the required PGlite IndexedDB setup, table creation, GIN index, insertion, and search; Response B uses localStorage and lacks any PGlite or full-text search logic.

scenarios.name: pgvector-embedding-search
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers almost all rubric items except the table name, while Response B misses several key requirements such as the correct import, PGlite instance, and HNSW index with vector_cosine_ops.

scenarios.name: react-live-query-updates
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required imports, PGlite instance with live extension, and a useLiveQuery hook, but misses the db.live.query subscription and unsubscribe; Response A lacks all required elements.
